main_body: bare gothic tree trunk and branches
evidence: The tree is drawn as a flat 2D side/front silhouette of a trunk and bare branches (rows 0-62), with the top of the branches cropped flat at row 0 and the base sitting on a flat 2px horizontal line (rows 60-62) rather than flaring into 3/4 roots.

style.evidence: Compared to the rich, multi-layered Beodeul trees with detailed root systems and textured bark/foliage, the candidate is a thin, banded silhouette with a heavy dark outline, simple vertical column shading on the trunk, and cropped branch tips at the top edge.
